sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Git: commit when asked
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: pack: agent-global — store in global personal
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Create git commits only when explicitly requested.

Before committing: git status, diff, recent log — then a concise message focused on why.
Never push unless asked.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Code: minimal focused diff
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: pack: agent-global — store in global personal
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
When changing code:

- Smallest correct fix only
- Match existing style and conventions
- No drive-by refactors or unrelated edits
- Reuse existing helpers instead of duplicating logic

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Agent: safe release run
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: pack: agent-global — store in global or personal
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
When executing a release for this workspace:

- Never delete untracked files without asking (other workspaces may use the same repos)
- Include untracked files in commits except obvious junk (.tmp, build artifacts)
- Push only when explicitly requested
- If a repo has no real changes, skip version bump and tag for that repo
